**Offline cache check (Chino, network disabled):** the app served the cached snapshot (`cached=true`) and showed "Cached: Class C • TFRs unverified" with a CAUTION badge. The overall verdict was DATA UNAVAILABLE, because live telemetry is mandatory. The class was Class C, not D, because ground elevation was also unavailable offline. The classifier then deliberately counted the Ontario Class C shelf (2,700 ft MSL) as possibly low. This is the designed behaviour: it may over-report airspace and never under-reports it. It is flagged by `AIR-ELEV-001`.
